thread:
Ana (Growth): Brainstorming for the benchmark narrative. Want a fresh angle beyond the usual two-chart hero.
Mike P: What about a tokens-per-dollar heatmap where rows are workload types and cols are serving profiles? Quick visual for ops + biz.
Drew (Prod): Heatmap is cool. Include a small column with p95 annotations so folks don't miss latency tradeoffs.
Sarah - Content: Tone: 'Estimate & choose' 1 consultative CTA. Also propose a short 90s explainer video for social.
Jon (Sales): If we include a 'compare with your current setup' flow in the kit, SDRs can see intent signals. Add a field for monthly token volume.
Design Bot: I'll mock a compact heatmap + tiny latency strip on the right. Keeps hero visually different.
Mike P: I'll produce the heatmap CSVs for chat, rerank, and embed workloads. Will annotate configs used.
Drew (Prod): Config note: we'll state batching, kv-cache, and quantization levels explicitly in the appendix. Also share a short shell script for the micro-benchmark.
Sarah - Content: CTA variations: A) 'Try a 2-min tokens-per-dollar heatmap' B) 'See how serving choices shift your bill'  leaner?
Ana (Growth): Prefer option A for clarity. We'll A/B test subject lines too.
Jon (Sales): Suggested webinar panel: product + customer + solutions engineer. Real-time demo of uploading a CSV to the kit.
Mike P: I'll add an export so visitors can download a one-row summary for their finance teams.
Drew (Prod): I'll prepare p95/p99 numbers and a tiny tail chart for the appendix slides.
Sarah - Content: I'll draft landing copy, email sequence (3 msgs), and the 90s explainer script.
Ana (Growth): Action items: Mike = heatmap data + export; Drew = config + latency artifacts + script; Sarah = copy + video script + emails; Design = heatmap hero comp; Jon = webinar outreach list. Target: mock + copy by Wed EOD.
Design Bot: Uploading first hero comp to /design/bench-heatmap-hero-v1.png
Mike P: CSVs to #marketing-assets in 30m.
Ana (Growth): Nice — this feels distinct from prior two-panel pieces. Keep hero high-level, put the config and raw numbers in appendix. :rocket:
